title: Compute Initial Degrees
description: Calculate the degree (number of neighbors) for each node in the graph. For weighted graphs, use the sum of edge weights as the weighted degree.

title: Create Degree Bins
description: Organize nodes into bins (buckets) based on their current degree. Each bin d contains all nodes with exactly degree d. This enables O(1) access to the minimum-degree nodes.

title: Iteratively Remove Minimum-Degree Nodes
description: Start from the smallest degree bin. Remove the first available node and assign it the current core number k. The core number of a removed node equals its degree at the moment of removal.

title: Update Neighbor Degrees
description: When a node is removed, decrement the degree of each of its neighbors by 1. Move each affected neighbor to the appropriate lower-degree bin. This maintains the invariant that bins reflect current degrees in the remaining subgraph.

title: Continue Until All Nodes Processed
description: Continue removing nodes and updating neighbors until all nodes are removed. The resulting core number for each node indicates the innermost k-core it belongs to.
